svg.title: B-spline Policy training
svg.desc: Each discrete demonstration is fitted with a cubic B-spline by inserting knots where the error is largest until the error is below a tolerance; knots cluster where the motion bends. At every observation the target is the next 16 knots and their control points, which cover a short time where the motion is fine and a long time where it is fast. The ACT-style network regresses these parameters. A looser tolerance compresses the demonstrations more with little change in score (Push-T, paper Table 3).
svg.text: BSP learns the curve behind each demonstration.

g.text: a demonstration is a list of joint targets
one joint shown, 50 Hz, 8 s; the paper records 200 to 300 per task

knots spend them where the motion needs detail
41 interior knots, dense at the grasp
a looser fit compresses more; the score barely moves
Push-T, paper Table 3 · ratio = actions per knot–control-point pair
real robot tasks use ε = 0.002 to keep precise motions
